Maria: midweek craving — looking for short, under-10-episode shows or albums for flights. Any recs? :airplane:
Aj: not short but 'Dark' is wild if you like timey-wimey stuff :mindblown:
Sam: short shows: 'Russian Doll' S1 (8 eps), 'Fleabag' S1 (6 eps) — both perfect single-flight binges
Olivia: music rec: Khruangbin — 'Mordechai' is great for headphones, super chill instrumental vibes :headphones:
Raj: shoutout to 'Lupin' S1 (5 eps) and 'The End of the F***ing World' S1 (8 eps) — quick and addictive
Zoe: movie recs for ~2hr flights: 'Palm Springs' or 'The Farewell' — both excellent
Ella: here’s a small playlist I made for travel: ```https://open.spotify.com/playlist/abcd1234``` — upbeat then mellow
Maria: @Ella dropping into my queue now :heart:
Sam: also 'The Bear' S1 episodes are ~25 mins each, great if you only have 30–40 minute pockets
Olivia: if you want instrumental albums: Nils Frahm's 'All Melody' or Tycho 'Epoch'
Zoe: audiobook rec: 'Project Hail Mary' — long but super engaging if you want one thing to start and not stop 
Aj: quick poll — movies vs short shows vs albums for travel? react with :popcorn: :tv: :musical_note:
